stem: What do these stage directions help the reader understand?
instruction:
Read line 3 from the play.

[The audience can be heard applauding halfheartedly.]

options.label: A
options.text: Pete is upset that nobody paid attention to his performance.

options.label: B
options.text: Pete’s performance did not go as well as he had hoped.

options.label: C
options.text: Pete had a difficult time hearing others while he was singing.

options.label: D
options.text: Pete’s friends are not supportive of his decision to sing.
